about:
# Livery

A WoW: Forever addon that keeps a family of sister guilds (`<Name> 1`,
`<Name> 2`, `<Name> II`, ...) wearing an identical guild tabard. Capture one
reference design, target other players, and get an unmistakable MATCH / NO
MATCH next to the target frame, plus a list of every sister guild you have
seen and how it compared.

Local-only: no network calls, no chat, whisper, guild or addon messages,
nothing posted anywhere on your behalf.

## Download

Grab `Livery-<version>.zip` from the [Releases page](https://github.com/KonigTX/Livery/releases) - one folder, nothing else to install.

## Install

Unzip, and drop the `Livery` folder into your WoW: Forever client's AddOns
folder. On the beta that is:

```
World of Warcraft/_classic_beta_/Interface/AddOns/Livery/
```

so that `Livery.toc` sits directly inside `Livery/`. Restart the client (or
`/reload`). Type `/livery`.

## Known issue on the beta client

The current Forever beta (1.60.1) writes addon saved variables but does not
read them back at login (a Blizzard client bug, reported as
ClassicWoWCommunity/forever-bugs#34). Livery saves everything correctly, but
after a logout your reference and the guild list may come back empty. Until
Blizzard fixes the client, either keep your share code (More > Export)
handy and paste it back in with More > Import after logging in, or install
[!ForeverSVBridge](https://github.com/KonigTX/ForeverSVBridge), a small
companion addon that restores every addon's saved variables at login.
Nothing in Livery needs changing when the fix lands.

## Using it

1. Target a player wearing the tabard everyone should match and click
   **Use target** (or click **Use my guild** if it is your own guild's).
2. Target anyone. The badge beside the target frame, and the Livery window,
   say **MATCH** or **NO MATCH** and name what differs (Background, Border,
   Emblem, Emblem colour). A guilded player not showing a tabard reads
   **No tabard**; an NPC or unguilded player reads **No guild**.
3. Every sister guild you target is listed in the window with its last result,
   when it was seen and on whom. Sister guilds are recognised by name: the
   family name is set automatically from the reference guild (" II" is
   a sister of ""), and you can add exact names under **More**.

The **?** button in the window shows the same three steps as a tooltip.
Every button explains itself on hover.

## More

The **More** button opens the rarely needed controls:

- **Share code**: Export puts a `LIVERY1:` code for the current reference in
  the box, selected for Ctrl+C. Paste a code and click Import to use someone
  else's reference. A bad code changes nothing.
- **Which guilds count as sisters**: "Starts with" (set automatically from the
  reference guild's name; blank means only the list) and "Also these"
  (comma-separated exact names). Other guilds still get a verdict but stay
  out of the list unless **Show other guilds** is on.
- **Show the MATCH / NO MATCH frame next to your target**: on by default.
  Drag the frame where you like; it remembers. Its X closes it; this checkbox
  brings it back. **Reset match frame position** puts it back beside the
  target frame.

## Commands

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/livery` | Open or close the Livery window |
| `/livery setmine` | Use your own guild's tabard as the reference |
| `/livery settarget` | Use your target's guild tabard as the reference |
| `/livery export` | Print a `LIVERY1:` share code for the current reference |
| `/livery import <code>` | Use a share code as the reference |
| `/livery probe` | Print the raw API diagnostic (for bug reports) |
| `/livery reset` | Reset the badge position |
| `/livery help` | Show this list |

`/lv` is a shorter alias. The minimap addon button opens the same window.

## How the comparison works

The client exposes every nearby player's guild tabard design (background
colour, border colour, emblem, emblem colour). Livery reads it for the
targeted player, no inspect required, and compares it field by field with the
reference. Colours are compared after rounding to 8 bits per channel, so two
guilds set up at the tabard vendor with the same choices always match.

If the design is not available for a target (typically because they are not
showing a guild tabard), the badge tries once more half a second later and
then reads **No tabard** rather than guessing.

## Known provisional values (re-check before shipping wider)

- **Guild tabard item id** (`Livery/Logic.lua`, `GUILD_TABARD_ITEM_ID`,
  currently `5976`): `/livery probe` prints `GetInventoryItemID("player", 19)`
  while a guild tabard is worn so this can be corrected if Forever's id
  differs. It is one named constant.
- **`X-Curse-Project-ID`** in `Livery.toc` is a placeholder until the addon
  is published.
- **Packager TOC suffix**: the BigWigs packager's Forever support is days old
  and its multi-TOC suffix (`_Camelot.toc`) is marked provisional by its
  maintainer. This addon ships one TOC (`## Interface: 16001`); re-check the
  packager notes before a multi-flavour release.

## Credits

Built by KonigTX (beta: Thunder Keg). Idea: Max Ran (beta).

releases.notes:
Guild-tabard consistency for World of Warcraft: Forever.

**Install:** unzip `Livery-1.0.0.zip` into `World of Warcraft/_classic_beta_/Interface/AddOns/` so that `Livery/Livery.toc` is inside `Livery/`, restart or `/reload`, then type `/livery`.

- Two buttons: **Use my guild** / **Use target** set the reference tabard.
- A MATCH / NO MATCH frame beside your target, naming what differs.
- A list of every sister guild you have targeted, in hierarchy order (OLYMPUS, OLYMPUS II, III, IX...).
- **More**: a share code so other officers check against the same reference, sister-guild name rules, frame options.
- **?** in the window explains the three steps.

Known beta issue: the current client does not read saved variables back at login (Blizzard bug), so keep your share code handy and re-import it after logging in. `Livery-1.0.0.zip.sha256` is the checksum of the zip.
